props.name: value
props.description: null (or a value that isn't finite) is indeterminate: work is happening, but how much is unknown.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is shown and announced.

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: The accessible text of the value, from the formatted value and the raw one.

parts.name: ProgressIndicator
parts.description: Its width is the share of the range done; it has none while indeterminate.

parts.name: ProgressValue
parts.description: The formatted value, hidden from assistive technology (the root announces it). Empty while indeterminate. For other text, put `progressValue(c)` on an element of your own and show what you like from the context.

parts.name: ProgressLabel
parts.description: Names the progress bar: the root's `aria-labelledby` points here.
